description: Integrate CopilotKit on top of the existing Vercel AI SDK agent. Add a floating popup assistant accessible from any authenticated page, generative UI that renders existing components inline (RenderIvaResume, VencimientosList, MiniKpiCards, RenderPdfInfo), contextual readability of the active client/profile, human-in-the-loop mutations for safe actions (scrape jobs, mark notification opened), and PDF drag-and-drop for bank statement scanning. The existing /chat page and its /api/agent endpoint MUST continue working unchanged — CopilotKit runs in parallel, not as a replacement. Gated by the existing 'ai_agent' module flag.
globalConstraints: All CopilotKit features must be gated by the 'ai_agent' module flag (via listOrgModules from src/actions/admin.tsx)
All server functions must call getSessionWithOrg() first and scope by orgId (multi-tenancy)
Never expose client.password or any AFIP credentials to the client/agent
Mutations must use human-in-the-loop confirmation (renderAndWaitForResponse pattern)
All commits must pass: bun run lint and TypeScript typecheck

userStories.title: Install CopilotKit deps and create runtime endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CopilotKit installed and a runtime endpoint mounted on the server so that the frontend can connect to a CopilotKit-compatible backend, without affecting the existing /api/agent endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `bun add @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/react-ui @copilotkit/runtime` and verify package.json updated

Create src/routes/api/copilotkit.ts as a TanStack Route exposing POST handler using `copilotRuntimeNodeHttpEndpoint` or `copilotRuntimeNextJSAppRouterEndpoint`-compatible adapter wired to Web standard Request/Response (TanStack Start uses Web Request)
Use `CopilotRuntime` from @copilotkit/runtime with a Google Generative AI service adapter using process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY and model 'gemini-2.5-flash'
Endpoint MUST call getSessionWithOrg() before processing; return 401 if no session, 403 if no active org
Minimal system instruction: 'Sos Arca Asistente, integrado en la plataforma del estudio contable. Respondés siempre en español rioplatense, tono profesional y directo. Nunca inventás datos.'
DO NOT modify src/routes/api/agent.ts, src/routes/_authed/chat/$id.tsx, or src/routes/_authed/chat/index.tsx
Run `bun run lint` — passes with no new errors
Run `bun run dev` — server boots without errors; manually open /chat and send a test message — existing agent at /api/agent continues to work and stream responses
userStories.notes: Phase 1 — Foundation. The TanStack Start route handler signature is `{ server: { handlers: { POST: async ({ request }) => Response } } }` — see existing src/routes/api/agent.ts for the pattern. CopilotKit's runtime accepts a Web Request and returns a Response, which fits TanStack Start. If the runtime requires Node-style req/res, wrap it. Reference: https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/classes/CopilotRuntime

userStories.title: Mount CopilotKit provider in _authed layout, gated by ai_agent module
userStories.description: As a studio operator, I want the CopilotKit provider only mounted when the 'ai_agent' module is enabled for my organization so that orgs without the module are not affected and don't pay for unused capacity.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/routes/_authed/route.tsx, fetch listOrgModules() via useQuery(['orgModules']) — same pattern as src/components/app-sidebar.tsx
When `ai_agent` is enabled, wrap children with `<CopilotKit runtimeUrl="/api/copilotkit" agent="default">` from @copilotkit/react-core
When `ai_agent` is disabled, render children WITHOUT the provider — no CopilotKit code paths run
Import CSS once: `import '@copilotkit/react-ui/styles.css'` (place inside the conditional branch or at the top of the route file — verify it does not leak when module is disabled)
Run `bun run lint` — passes
Manual: with ai_agent enabled in /admin → app loads, no console errors; with ai_agent disabled → app loads, no CopilotKit-related network calls or runtime errors
Manual: existing /chat page continues working in both states
userStories.notes: Phase 1. The provider must NOT block render. Reference: useQuery key ['orgModules'] used by app-sidebar.tsx. Module flag values from src/actions/admin.tsx listOrgModules().

userStories.title: Render CopilotPopup as floating assistant, hidden on /chat routes
userStories.description: As a studio operator, I want a floating assistant button visible on every page except the dedicated /chat page so that I can ask questions without navigating away from my current context.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `<CopilotPopup>` from @copilotkit/react-ui inside the CopilotKit provider in src/routes/_authed/route.tsx
Use `useLocation()` from @tanstack/react-router to hide the popup when pathname starts with `/chat` (avoid double UI on the dedicated chat page)
Provide Spanish labels via the `labels` prop: title='Asistente Arca', initial='¿En qué puedo ayudarte?', placeholder='Preguntale al asistente…'
The popup loads even with zero registered actions (just chat with the model)
Run `bun run lint` — passes
Verify in browser:
- Go to / (dashboard), /clients, /sueldos, /notifications — popup button visible bottom-right
- Open the popup, send 'hola' → model responds in Spanish
- Go to /chat or /chat/<some-id> → popup button is NOT visible
- Existing /chat conversation continues working with no regression
userStories.notes: Phase 1. CopilotPopup is preferred over CopilotSidebar for low-intrusion UX (no layout shift). Reference: https://docs.copilotkit.ai/reference/components/CopilotPopup

userStories.title: Generative UI for IVA position via useCopilotAction
userStories.description: As a studio operator, I want to ask the assistant for a client's IVA position and see the result rendered as the existing RenderIvaResume component inline in the chat so that I get the full visual breakdown without navigating to the client page.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/actions/copilot.tsx with a server function `getIvaPositionForCopilot` that mirrors the logic in src/routes/api/agent.ts lines ~410-580 (the getIvaPosition tool). It MUST: call getSessionWithOrg(), validate clientName matches exactly one client in the org, fetch profiles, fetch ivaScrape for prevMonth, fetch invoices for displayMonth, call calcularIvaDesdeFacturas from @/lib/iva-calc, return the same shape as the existing tool
Create src/components/copilot/CopilotActions.tsx — a client component that registers actions via hooks. It returns null (no UI of its own).

Inside CopilotActions.tsx, register `useCopilotAction({ name: 'getIvaPosition', description, parameters: [{name: 'clientName', type: 'string', required: true}, {name: 'displayMonth', type: 'string', required: false, description: 'MM/YYYY'}], handler: async (args) => await getIvaPositionForCopilot({data: args}), render: ({status, args, result}) => <RenderIvaResume data={result} /> })`
Mount `<CopilotActions />` inside the CopilotKit provider scope in src/routes/_authed/route.tsx, only when ai_agent module is enabled
Run `bun run lint` — passes
Verify in browser: go to /, open popup, ask 'IVA de [un cliente real] en marzo 2026' → after a brief loading state, RenderIvaResume renders inline with the IVA breakdown for that client
DO NOT modify src/routes/api/agent.ts
userStories.notes: Phase 2 — Generative UI. The existing component is at src/components/render-iva-resume.tsx — inspect its props before wiring. The IVA logic is duplicated for now from /api/agent.ts; future stories may consolidate into a shared lib in src/lib/iva-position.ts. Use calcularIvaDesdeFacturas from @/lib/iva-calc as the existing agent does.

userStories.title: Active client/profile context via useCopilotReadable
userStories.description: As a studio operator, when I'm on a client or profile detail page, I want the assistant to know which entity I'm looking at so that I can ask 'qué facturó este mes' without restating the client name.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/components/client-detail-page.tsx, add `useCopilotReadable({ description: 'Cliente actualmente visible en pantalla', value: { id: client.id, name: client.name, identityNumber: client.identityNumber, fiscalCondition: client.fiscalCondition, status: client.status } })` — NEVER include client.password or any credential

In src/components/profile-detail-page.tsx, add `useCopilotReadable({ description: 'Profile fiscal actualmente visible en pantalla', value: { id: profile.id, name: profile.name, identityNumber: profile.identityNumber, clientId: profile.clientId, status: profile.status } })`

userStories.title: Human-in-the-loop action: dispararScrape via useCopilotAction
userStories.description: As a studio operator, when looking at a client, I want to ask the assistant to dispatch a scrape job, see a confirmation card with the details, and only execute on my approval so that I never trigger a job by accident.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/copilot/ScrapeConfirmation.tsx — a presentation component that takes `{ clientName, jobType, onConfirm, onCancel }` and renders a card with two buttons (Confirmar / Cancelar)

In src/components/copilot/CopilotActions.tsx, register `useCopilotAction({ name: 'dispararScrape', description: 'Dispara un job de scraping para un cliente. Pide confirmación antes de ejecutar.', parameters: [{name: 'clientId', type: 'string', required: true}, {name: 'jobType', type: 'string', enum: ['iva','comprobantes','notificaciones','deuda','vencimientos'], required: true}], renderAndWaitForResponse: ({args, respond, status}) => status === 'executing' ? <ScrapeConfirmation clientName={...} jobType={args.jobType} onConfirm={() => respond('confirmado')} onCancel={() => respond('cancelado')} /> : null, handler: async (args, response) => { if (response !== 'confirmado') return { cancelled: true }; return await scrapSingleJob({data: {clientId: args.clientId, type: args.jobType}}) } })`
Use the existing server function scrapSingleJob from src/actions/client.tsx
Combine with US-007: in /clients/$id, the assistant has the client context — asking 'scrapeame las facturas' uses the active client's id
Run `bun run lint` — passes
Verify in browser:
- Go to /clients/<some-id> with US-007 context active
- Open popup, ask 'scrapeame las facturas de este cliente' (or 'corré comprobantes')
- Confirmation card appears with client name + job type
- Click Cancelar → no job dispatched (verify in /jobs that no new job appeared)
- Repeat and click Confirmar → job appears in /jobs with status pending or running
DO NOT modify src/routes/api/agent.ts
userStories.notes: Phase 3 — HITL. CopilotKit's renderAndWaitForResponse pattern is documented at https://docs.copilotkit.ai/guides/human-in-the-loop. The component in src/components/copilot/ScrapeConfirmation.tsx should use shadcn UI primitives (Card, Button) consistent with the rest of the app.

userStories.title: PDF drag-and-drop attachment in CopilotPopup
userStories.description: As a studio operator, I want to drag a PDF onto the assistant popup so that I can attach a bank statement or document for processing without leaving my current context.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/copilot/AttachmentBar.tsx — a small bar mounted above the CopilotPopup input that: accepts drag-and-drop of PDF files (single file at a time, max 10MB), reads file as base64, stores in a context/state, shows preview (filename, size, X to clear)

Use a React Context `CopilotAttachmentContext` (src/components/copilot/AttachmentContext.tsx) that holds `{ file: { name, size, base64 } | null, setFile, clear }` so actions can read the attached file

Wire CopilotPopup so the AttachmentBar appears inside or just above the input area; alternatively, register a custom InputProps slot if the API supports it. Acceptable workaround: render `<AttachmentBar />` as a floating element inside the popup using fixed positioning + z-index
Reject non-PDF files with a toast: `toast.error('Solo se aceptan archivos PDF')`
Reject files > 10MB with a toast: `toast.error('Archivo demasiado grande (máximo 10MB)')`
Run `bun run lint` — passes
Verify in browser: open popup, drag a PDF onto it → preview shows filename and size; click X → preview clears; drag a non-PDF → toast error; drag a 15MB file → toast error
DO NOT modify src/routes/api/agent.ts
userStories.notes: Phase 4 — Scan PDF. CopilotKit may not have first-class file upload yet; use a custom approach. Reference Sonner toast pattern from src/conventions. The AttachmentContext is consumed by US-011 action.

Procesando…
